WTO | Services - Schedules of commitments and lists of Article II
Schedules  of specific commitments and lists of Article II exemptions
During the Uruguay Round of negotiations (1986-1994), participating  countries undertook specific commitments on market access and national  treatment, which are contained in their original services schedules. Some  participating countries also drew up a list of MFN exemptions.
After the Uruguay Round, extended negotiations took place under the GATS  on the movement of natural persons (concluded in 1995), telecommunications (concluded  in 1997),financial services (concluded in 1997), and maritime transport  services (suspended in 1996). Commitments undertaken in these extended  negotiations supplement or replace the original commitments.
While not all WTO members participated in the extended negotiations, the  outcomes of these negotiations are applied on an MFN basis.
